title: Interfacial reactions take the lead: elucidating the dominant role of cathode–electrolyte interactions in triggering thermal runaway of high-nickel lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01431J, Paper
Zhaoxuan Jiang, Chengao Liu, Lang Huang, Shanshan Zhu, Xiaohu Zhang, Rongxian Wu, Tianyu Gong, Yuhan Wu, Lingxiang Guo, Pengxian Han, Jun Ma, Gaojie Xu, Guanglei Cui
Thermal runaway in moderate-Ni cathode cells stems from bulk oxygen release, while high-Ni cathode ones rely on interfacial reactions, with electrolyte decomposition exacerbating cracking, forming a self-sustaining degradation loop.
